newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Timah Langat changes name to MNI Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Timah Langat changes name to MNI Holdings.

text.p: Malaysian mining and electrical goods manufacturer Timah Langat Bhd announced it has changed its name to MNI Holdings Bhd.
It said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) that its shareholders have approved the change in name at an extraordinary general meeting on Friday.
"Upon completion of our restructuring, we would like to request you to change the listing and quotation of our counter from the mining sector to the finance sector," the company said.
Malaysia National Insurance Sdn Bhd (MNI), the country's third largest insurance company, was in May this year injected into Timah, then a small manufacturing firm.
State investment fund Permodalan Nasional Bhd holds an 80 percent stake in the enlarged capital of Timah, after earlier selling its 70 percent stake in MNI to Timah.
